book.title: 影子为什么跟着我
book.subtitle: 光被挡住后的黑色伙伴
book.question: 影子为什么跟着我？

moral.zh: 身体挡住光，另一侧就会出现较暗的影子；人移动时，挡光的位置也一起移动。
moral.en: When a body blocks light, it makes a darker area on the other side that moves with the body.

pages.enText: After school, Lele jumps across the playground. Hey, the dark shadow jumps too!
